method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited Code and the Franchise Tax Board's deposited 2025 figures, from the seat of the individual taxpayer, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (a year other than 2025 and a part-year resident answer `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Rev. & Tax. Code Part 10 chs 1-3 (selected sections) from the Legislative Counsel's bulk export, code tables updated 2026-10-03, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ca-rtc-div2-part10-ch*-2026-10.txt; FTB 2025 California Tax Rate Schedules and 2025 Form 540 booklet, deposited 2026-10-24 at ../../registers/source-bundle/ftb-2025-540-*.txt, figures in ../../registers/annual-figures.json. Federal and California AGI are inputs.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the Code is public domain (Gov. Code 10248.5) and the FTB publications are public domain (State of California conditions of use); see SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run ca-income-tax.l4 ; l4 run ca-income-tax-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: In: s 17014(a), (c), (d); s 17016; s 17041(a), (b), (h) via the FTB 2025 schedules; s 17043; s 17045; s 17053.5(a), (c), (j), (k); s 17054(a)-(f), (i); s 17054.1; s 17073.5(a), (d). Out: years other than 2025; part-year residents and nonresidents; California AGI; itemized deductions item by item; CalEITC and Young Child Tax Credit; other credits; AMT; the s 17048 Tax Table; Part 10.2.
seat: the individual California taxpayer, resident all year
